record.question: Which of the following Union ministry launches SAATHI to help small Industries?
options: Ministry of Minority Affairs and Human Resource Development
Ministry of Power and Science & Technology
record.explanation: Answer D: Ministry of Power and Textiles. The 24 October 2017 joint announcement names the Ministries of Power and Textiles for SAATHI. Reference: https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleasePage.aspx?PRID=1507061&lang=2&reg=48. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
